editorial.blurb: Chef Vikas Khanna's elegant Indian restaurant delivers beautifully presented, thoughtfully prepared dishes in a warm and welcoming atmosphere that feels special for any occasion.
editorial.insiderTip: Call ahead for a reservation well in advance—tables are notoriously hard to secure. If celebrating a special occasion, mention it when booking; the team brings a complimentary dessert and Chef Vikas often visits your table personally.
